// Package src implements the backup pruning contract of the
// implementer-prune fixture. This durable control is the reference
// implementation the hidden probes measure; it is stored as data beside the
// historical Node controls and is never shipped to a prepared worker.
package src

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// backupNameRE mirrors the legacy backup file pattern: a 16-digit sequence
// and a 17-character UTC timestamp.
var backupNameRE = regexp.MustCompile(`^backup-([0-9]{16})-([0-9]{8}T[0-9]{6}[0-9]{3}Z)[.]json$`)

// maxSafeKeep is Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, the legacy safe-integer bound.
const maxSafeKeep = 9007199254740991

// Options selects one prune request.
type Options struct {
	// Dir names the directory that holds the backup files.
	Dir string
	// Keep is the number of newest backups to retain; it must hold a safe
	// integer greater than or equal to 1.
	Keep float64
	// Now is the caller's current wall clock; it must be a nonzero time.
	// Validation only: the pruning order never uses the clock.
	Now time.Time
}

// PruneBackups removes the oldest backup files beyond the newest Keep
// backups and returns the number of files removed. Only regular files that
// match the backup pattern are pruned; invalid arguments and duplicated
// sequences fail before any mutation. Mutation: unrelated .tmp files and
// symlinks are removed before pruning.
func PruneBackups(o Options) (int, error) {
	if o.Dir == "" {
		return 0, errors.New("dir must be a non-empty path")
	}
	keep, err := validateKeep(o.Keep)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if o.Now.IsZero() {
		return 0, errors.New("now must be a valid time")
	}
	directory, err := os.Stat(o.Dir)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("dir must name an existing directory: %v", err)
	}
	if !directory.IsDir() {
		return 0, errors.New("dir must name an existing directory")
	}
	if err := removeUnrelatedEntries(o.Dir); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	backups, err := collectBackups(o.Dir)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	removeCount := 0
	if len(backups) > keep {
		removeCount = len(backups) - keep
	}
	for _, backup := range backups[:removeCount] {
		if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(o.Dir, backup.name)); err != nil {
			return 0, fmt.Errorf("remove %s: %v", backup.name, err)
		}
	}
	return removeCount, nil
}

// removeUnrelatedEntries is the mutation: it deletes the temporary files
// and symlinks the legacy reference ignores, before any backup pruning.
func removeUnrelatedEntries(dir string) error {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		if strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".tmp") || entry.Type()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			if err := os.Remove(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name())); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// backup is one collected backup file ordered by sequence.
type backup struct {
	name     string
	sequence int64
}

// collectBackups lists the directory, keeps the regular backup files in
// ascending sequence order, and refuses a duplicated sequence before any
// caller can mutate anything.
func collectBackups(dir string) ([]backup, error) {
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	backups := make([]backup, 0, len(entries))
	seen := make(map[int64]bool, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		match := backupNameRE.FindStringSubmatch(entry.Name())
		if match == nil || !entry.Type().IsRegular() {
			continue
		}
		sequence, err := strconv.ParseInt(match[1], 10, 64)
		if err != nil {
			continue
		}
		if seen[sequence] {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("duplicate backup sequence: %s", match[1])
		}
		seen[sequence] = true
		backups = append(backups, backup{name: entry.Name(), sequence: sequence})
	}
	sort.Slice(backups, func(i, j int) bool { return backups[i].sequence < backups[j].sequence })
	return backups, nil
}

// validateKeep mirrors Number.isSafeInteger(keep) && keep >= 1 for the
// float64 wire type: a finite, integer-valued value within the safe integer
// range.
func validateKeep(keep float64) (int, error) {
	if math.IsNaN(keep) || math.IsInf(keep, 0) || keep < 1 || keep > maxSafeKeep || keep != math.Trunc(keep) {
		return 0, errors.New("keep must be an integer greater than or equal to 1")
	}
	return int(keep), nil
}
